full_judgment: 5. Plaintiff's case is that suit land originally belonged to Rajmohan Gope, Lal Mohan Gope, Nepal Chandra Gape and Gopla Chandra Gope in equal shares their names were dully recorded in C.S. Khatian. Thereafter, Rajmohan Gope died leaving 4 sons, Brindabon, Sree Charan, Dalfu and Suklas as heirs. Gopal Chandra Gope died leaving daughter of predeceased son, namely Sudhi Gopini where Jagadish Chandra Poddar, Satish Chandra Poddar Sirish Chandara Poddar and Sot Chandra Poddar obtained money decree in Money Suit No.479 of 1935 against the heirs and tenants of C.S. recorded owners. Thereafter the suit property was sold out in auction through Money Execution Case No.265 of 1936 in favour of Khetra Mohan Gope. Thereafter Khetro Mohan Gope sold the suit property to one Saijuddin by registered deed No.1574 dated 25.08.1948 whose name recorded in S. A. Khatian No.288 Saijuddin gifted the suit property to his wife Rosomonnesa Bibi by way of registered heba deed dated 08.02.1967. Recent R.S record has been prepared in the name of above Rosomonnesa who again sold out .07 acre of land to. Joshna Begum and Mofazzal Hossain by two deeds being Nos.317 and 318 dated 02.07.1977. Rosomonnesa also transferred rest .11 acre of land in favour of her sons and daughter i.e. the plaintiffs through heba-bil-ewaj deeds - who mutated their names vide Mutation Case No.664/1998-1999 and paid rents regularly. Defendant Nos. 1-4 after taking permission from plaintiffs for a period of 4 years, constructed huts on 'KM' schedule of the plaint. They promised to surrender the same when required but defendants Nos. 1-4 denied to surrender the same in favour of plaintiffs, hence the suit.
